method.reference: Node 24.22.0 drives unchanged upstream dist (oauth.js, project.js, auth.js) and Pi source (credential-cache.ts, stream.ts, credential-redaction.ts) through loopback HTTP fake servers; sha256 of every imported upstream file is asserted; entropy, wall clock and request IDs are injected

limits: Loaded-library OAuth login through the native cdylib is not exercised here: the production OAuth token/userinfo fetch uses a direct reqwest client with no proxy and hardcoded Google endpoints, so a loopback fake server cannot intercept it, and the rpi host binary available in this environment does not expose the native-auth CLI (`auth methods`) that the existing loaded acceptance scripts require. This is a missing injectable-endpoint/proxy capability plus a missing host build, not a normalization.
The malformed-JSON diagnostics cover valid UTF-8 bodies only; lone UTF-16 surrogate inputs are reported lossily because a Rust String cannot hold them.

Rust serde_json and V8 JSON.parse accept the same strict JSON, so the V8 diagnostic is only consulted after serde_json rejects a body; divergence is limited to inputs where serde_json rejects and V8 accepts (none found in the corpus).
